definitions.gloss: to wake with a stiff neck; to sleep in an awkward position
definitions.explanation: to sleep in an uncomfortable position that causes neck pain or stiffness upon waking

examples.english: I woke up with a stiff neck.

examples.japanese: {寝違|ねちが}えて{首|くび}が{回|まわ}らない。
examples.english: I can't turn my neck because I slept wrong.

examples.japanese: {枕|まくら}が{合|あ}わなくて{寝違|ねちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: The pillow didn't suit me and I woke with a stiff neck.

notes:
{寝違|ねちが}える means to sleep in an awkward position and wake up with neck or shoulder pain. A very common everyday ailment.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive), but often used with {首|くび}を as the affected body part
- Pattern: {首|くび}を{寝違|ねちが}える

ASPECT (ている):
{寝違|ねちが}えている describes the ongoing state of having a stiff neck from sleeping wrong.

NOUN FORM:
- {寝違|ねちが}え: stiff neck from sleeping (e.g., {寝違|ねちが}えがひどい)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {首|くび}を{寝違|ねちが}えた: I woke with a stiff neck
- {寝違|ねちが}えて{首|くび}が{回|まわ}らない: my neck won't turn because I slept wrong
- {枕|まくら}が{合|あ}わなくて{寝違|ねちが}えた: the pillow didn't suit me and I got a stiff neck

COMMON CAUSES:
Often happens with an unfamiliar {枕|まくら} (pillow), sleeping in an unusual position, or on a {硬|かた}い surface.
